 LIHEAP Application Open To Help With Energy Bills
 Posted By: Tyler Friel on: November 05, 2026 In: Featured News Print Email 
 Application for grants to help with energy bills has now opened.
 Pennsylvania’s Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program (LIHEAP) has officially opened for the season.
 Eligible households can receive between $200 to $1,000 to help pay for monthly energy as winter approaches and bills increase.
 View more on the LIHEAP program here .
